title: Prototyping OSA: A New Framework for Predicting Cardiovascular Outcomes and CPAP Benefit
summary: A secondary SAVE-trial analysis uses data-driven OSA phenotypes to identify differences in cardiovascular risk and model-estimated CPAP response; the result is exploratory and limited to this cohort.
